raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: typeline
  version: "3.0.1"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: bd33243e4b43e978ecbcffbe003b7469ae956a42e87d95d9c1f9bff439f43f11

build:
  number: 0
  skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - maturin >=1.15,<2
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - python
    - if: is_abi3
      then: python-abi3
    - maturin >=1.15,<2
    - pip
  run:
    - python
    - msgspec >=0.20
    - typing-extensions >=4.12

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - typeline
        - typeline._native
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - "*"
        - if: is_abi3
          then: ${{ python_min }}.*
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
    script:
      - pytest tests -p no:cacheprovider -k "not test_a_wide_header_is_matched_quickly"
  - if: is_abi3
    then:
      requirements:
        run:
          - abi3audit
      script:
        - if: win
          then: abi3audit %SP_DIR%\typeline\_native.pyd -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
          else: abi3audit $SP_DIR/typeline/_native.abi3.so -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/clintval/typeline
  summary: Write dataclasses to delimited text formats and read them back again.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  repository: https://github.com/clintval/typeline
  documentation: https://github.com/clintval/typeline/blob/${{ version }}/README.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - clintval
